extracted.name: Pumpkin Spice Dutch Babies
extracted.description: This pumpkin spice Dutch baby recipe combines warm cinnamon, ginger, cloves, and nutmeg for an impressive fall brunch that’s ready in 30 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Preheat a cast iron skillet over high heat.
Blend milk, eggs, flour, cinnamon, ginger, allspice, salt, vanilla extract, cloves, and nutmeg together in a blender until batter is smooth.
Melt clarified butter in the preheated skillet; pour in batter.
Bake on the middle rack of the preheated oven until golden brown and puffed up to your liking, 20 to 25 minutes. Dust with powdered sugar.
